# Story template

Rules: [`story.md`](story.md). Delete any optional section you don't need.

**Summary**

```text
[Code Dependency value, optional] As a <Persona>, I want <behavior> so that <outcome>.
```

**Description**

```text
Context
<1–3 sentences: the problem and who it affects.>

Current behavior            (only when existing behavior changes)
<What happens today.>

Acceptance criteria
AC1: Given <state>, When <action>, Then <observable result>.
AC2: Given <state>, When <action>, Then <observable result>.
AC3 (regression): Given <state>, When <action>, Then the existing <behavior> still applies.
AC4 (access): Given a user with the <roles> profile, the <element> is visible; given <other roles>, it is hidden.

Constraints                 (only non-negotiable rules, each with its reason)
- <Rule>, because <reason>.

Out of scope                (optional)
- <Item>

Open questions              (must be empty before AC approval)
- [Business] <Question>
- [Engineering] <Question>
- [QA] <Question>

Changelog                   (after AC approval only)
- YYYY-MM-DD: AC<n> changed: <what and why>.
```

**Fields:** Story Points (5 or less) · Code Dependency · Pull Requests · Epic · Fix Version (set at Ready for Dev) · market label (non-US only)
